reason: A pure front-end DSH web UI plugin that adds clickable, hoverable turn markers beside conversations for message navigation and scroll-position tracking, with no external requests or host logic described.

summaries.zh: 为 DSH 网页会话在左侧添加按用户消息显示的标记条，支持点击跳转、悬停预览和随滚动定位。
summaries.en: Adds a left-side turn-mark strip to DSH web conversations for clicking to jump to user messages, hovering for previews, and tracking the visible message while scrolling.

capabilities: Adds a conversation-side turn-mark navigation strip
Reads locally available user-message metadata and content for previews
Scrolls the conversation to selected messages
Tracks the visible message while scrolling
